summary: Prove arbitrary candidate instruction order and derive barrier timing for the parallel dense forward kernel.

examined.reason: All candidate forward traces now inherit strict per-thread site order; every emitted store is classified against the actual instruction list and each thread/site pair occurs at most once. Timing around observed phases is derived. Computed-address ownership, required producer/phase existence and universal stored-output correctness remain open.

Reusable straight-line control proofs derive event-site ordering and completion timing from existing machine steps, with arbitrary reads, arithmetic results and schedules. The visibility rule uses site evidence instead of assumed trace timing while retaining explicit graph validity, unique-location writer and actual phase obligations. No semantics changed.
The same pinned build, no-placeholder guards and exact standard-axiom audit cover 27 new public declarations. These are internal model theorems; no new source-fidelity or hardware-conformance claim.

The child strengthens its universal-execution infrastructure while preserving explicit computation, numerical and scheduling boundaries. Its selected end-to-end result remains unchanged; the broader example responsibility still distinguishes implemented and missing obligations.

The child derives facts from the unchanged fetched machine, preserving arbitrary load candidates and binary32 results. No claim of general straight-line behavior is applied to programs with branches, no runtime or hardware correspondence is added, and no fairness or termination premise is inferred.

results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; bash integration/torchlean/check.sh; stratic validate; git diff --check; manual proof and scope review; explicit public-declaration inventory comparison.
results.environment: Pinned Lean 4.34.0 and unchanged TorchLean/numerical dependency revisions; 66 default integration targets. No GPU execution, benchmarking, external model calls or dependency updates.
results.evidence: Both full suites exited 0. Root source/build/proof checks passed with 1643 dependency reports. Integration passed with 968 exact reports; all 27 new public declarations use only standard Lean axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), with no proof placeholders or new unchecked axioms. All four dense interpreter/replay checks passed. Stratic validation and whitespace checks pass. Before/after snapshots are identical. Manual review checked unrestricted candidate choices, all dispatch outcomes, trace-site uniqueness, actual completion timing, preserved explicit visibility obligations and full emitted-store site classification. Logs: /tmp/control-root-check.log and /tmp/control-integration-check.log.
